product_lines.name: 10-Mil Heavy Duty Poly
product_lines.description: Professional-grade 10-mil poly for demanding applications. Reinforced corners for extra durability. Ideal for construction sites, debris covers, and outdoor storage.

product_lines.name: 12-Mil Extra Heavy Duty Poly
product_lines.description: Extreme duty 12-mil with sewn-in rope perimeter for maximum strength. Built for roofing, scaffold enclosures, and heavy-duty outdoor use. Lasts 1-3+ years.

product_lines.name: 16-Mil Super Heavy Duty Poly
product_lines.description: Industrial-grade super heavy-duty poly. Used by contractors and farmers for long-term outdoor applications and permanent storage structures.

product_lines.name: 20-Mil Ultra Heavy Duty Poly
product_lines.description: Ultra-heavy 20-mil tarp for extreme conditions. Maximum strength for permanent commercial covers, extreme weather, and years of continuous use.

product_lines.name: 5-Mil Light Duty Poly
product_lines.description: Lightweight poly tarp for temporary use. Great for camping, home projects, furniture covers, and general outdoor use.

product_lines.name: 7-Mil Standard Duty Poly
product_lines.description: Multi-purpose 7-mil poly tarp for versatile indoor and outdoor use. Works -50F to 180F. Balanced durability for equipment covers, truck beds, and construction ground protection.

product_lines.name: 10 oz Cotton Canvas Tarp
product_lines.description: 10oz cotton canvas tarp. Water-resistant (not waterproof). Double stitched hem. Breathable — ideal for covering items that need air circulation. Perfect for machinery, vehicles, and materials that should not trap moisture.

product_lines.name: Heavy Cotton Canvas Tarp
product_lines.description: Traditional breathable cotton canvas. Used for painting drop cloths, vehicle covers, and applications where air circulation matters.

product_lines.name: Clear Vinyl Tarp (20 Mil)
product_lines.description: Heavy duty 20 mil clear vinyl tarp. Optically super clear for visibility. 100% waterproof. Cold resistant to -30°F. Ideal for enclosures, windbreaks, restaurant patios, and any application where see-through weatherproofing is needed.

product_lines.name: Clear Vinyl Tarp (30 Mil)
product_lines.description: Super heavy duty 30 mil clear vinyl tarp. Maximum clarity and thickness for permanent installations. 100% waterproof. Cold resistant. Best for commercial enclosures and high-wind environments.

product_lines.name: Fire Retardant Clear Vinyl Tarp
product_lines.description: Fire retardant 20 mil clear vinyl tarp. Meets fire code requirements. 100% waterproof. Optically clear. Required for commercial construction in many jurisdictions. Ideal for welding curtains and fire-rated enclosures.

product_lines.name: Fire Retardant Poly Tarp
product_lines.description: NFPA 701 rated fire retardant. Self-extinguishing when flame removed. Required for welding areas, electrical work, and OSHA-regulated job sites.

product_lines.name: Mesh Tarp
product_lines.description: Black mesh polypropylene tarp. Double-stitched hems, tear resistant. Provides 60% shade while allowing airflow. Perfect for shade structures, privacy screens, debris containment, dump trucks, and fence covers.
